blocks.text: The Mobile App Store Control policy protects users from inadvertently downloading mobile apps from unauthorized or risky app stores. You can define a Mobile App Store Control policy to restrict the app stores from which users are prevented from downloading mobile apps to their mobile devices. When an app store is listed in the policy, users can browse the restricted app stores, but are blocked from downloading apps from those stores. Restricting users to using only official or approved app stores reduces the likelihood that users can download apps from sites that might contain vulnerabilities or that are fake copies of well-known apps.
The Mobile App Store Control provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Define policies to protect users from downloading malicious or unauthorized apps.
View and modify all existing app store policies, including Zscaler's recommended policies.
Restrict users to only be able to download apps from official app stores.

blocks.text: When no policy is configured, the default action is to allow app downloads from all app stores.
You can define a list of blocked app stores. Users can browse the app stores in the list, but they are blocked from downloading apps from the app stores.
If your organization has the Mobile Security subscription, you can also define a policy to prevent users from downloading malicious apps. To learn more, see Understanding Mobile Malware Protection.

blocks.heading: About the Mobile App Store Control Page

blocks.text: On the Mobile App Store Control page (Internet Access > Policy > Mobile App Store Control), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Optionally, filter the rules to limit the mobile app store control rules displayed in the table. You can filter by:
Rule State: Display the rules based on the state of the rule, either Enabled or Disabled.
Label: Displays the rules based on the rule labels. The rules are grouped under the associated rule labels. Choose Select All to view all rule labels.
Click Clear to remove all filters.
View the policy Zscaler recommends.
Add a Mobile App Store Control policy rule.
Search for a mobile app control rule.
Select the columns you want to view in the table.
View a list of all mobile app store control rules. For each mobile app store control rule, you can view the following information (not all columns are shown by default):
Rule Order: The order of the rule. You can sort this column.
Rule Name: The name of the rule. You can sort this column.
Rule Action: The action defined by the rule, either Block or Allow.
Admin Rank: The assigned admin rank for the rule. This is visible only if admin ranking is enabled in the Advanced Settings.
By default, the admin ranking is disabled. To use this feature, you must enable Admin Rank in Internet Access > Setting > Advanced Settings. To learn more, see Configuring Advanced Settings.
State: The state of this rule, either Enabled or Disabled.
Labels: The optional labels of the policy rule, if available.
Departments: The departments assigned to the rule.
App Stores: The app stores assigned to the rule.
Groups: The groups assigned to the rule.
Users: The users assigned to the rule.
Locations: The locations assigned to the rule.
Location Groups: The location groups assigned to the rule.
Time Windows: The time windows for the rule.
Description: The label and description of the rule, if available.
Criteria: The criteria defined for the rule.
Action: The actions you can take for the rule: edit, copy, or delete.
Edit a policy rule.
Duplicate a policy rule.
Delete a policy rule.
